text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before the Oaks began, as I was walking 
around the venue to check out the other 
races—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Catching my interest, I picked up a sports 
newspaper. Written inside was—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"'The Empress' aims for an Oaks 
master-pupil triumph with her beloved 
disciple! The heavily favored Admire 
Groove is the clear-cut top pick!"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Wh... What is with this article...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ah... so you really didn't know. I hear 
it's selling really well, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"...Is it true? The contents of this 
article, I mean."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
As if that's true! Running away in the 
middle of our talk—what kind of 'beloved 
student' does that?!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, what an absurd, sensationalized 
article! I'll file a complaint later.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: T-That's true...

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"...However, there is one undeniable 
truth. Today's favorite is without a doubt 
that girl."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love demonstrated immense ability 
in the Oka Sho. However—

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
"Normally, she should be able to deliver 
an equally, if not more, incredible burst 
of speed. As long as she doesn't tense 
up—"

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
This year's Queen of the Oaks is Admire 
Groove.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even on the way back to the waiting room 
where Still in Love was, all I could hear 
was—

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Admire Groove is... Alveâ âAdmire 
Groove surelyâ Alve-san this timeâ

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural. I... don't really stand 
out, after all.
choice_data_list: Still, you're the one who won the Oka Sho.
Still, you're the one who won the Oka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"However... the Oaks is a different story. 
It's only natural for people's 
expectations to shift..."
choice_data_list:
That might be true, but... it's still 
frustrating.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Are you... frustrated?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was the same after the Oka Sho. Even 
when she proved her strength, she was 
drowned out by the other voices. But she 
had become a Tiara Umamusume now, so—
choice_data_list: You deserve to be loved so much more

You deserve to be loved so much more, and 
yet...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I-Indeed... I would be happy if that 
happened... but...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...As long as you're watching me, I—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, um... well.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
B-But in reality... I can certainly 
understand why everyone's expectations are 
on Alve-san...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"No Oka Sho winning Umamusume has won the 
Oaks in recent years, though..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
There were moments when even I felt... 
perhaps this distance might be a bit too 
tough for me...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love murmured softly. That 
anxiety was undoubtedly how she truly 
felt. In that case—
choice_data_list:
If it's tough, then let it be tough, I 
guess?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: What?!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer-san... Which one is it...!?
choice_data_list: Of course I believe in you, but—
Of course I believe in you, but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seems a bit too tense. At this rate, 
she won't be able to show what she's truly 
capable of... I wish she had approached it 
a little more relaxed.
choice_data_list:
If it's just a matter of distance 
aptitude, I can live with that.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: T-That might be true, but...
choice_data_list: So go out there and run your heart out.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
choice_data_list: If you do that— you're sure to win
If you do that— you will surely win

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Please, let me make a promise. ...That I 
will win today, too!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Even with the Double Tiara right before 
their eyes... they still consider my 
feelings.)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: (This is no time to be anxious—)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"It's okay... It's going to be okay... I 
pulled it off in the Oka Sho, didn't 
I...?"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I will win, and dedicate it to her. 
――To that person."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(And if it makes them happy just once 
more... That's all I could ask for.)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (—Waaaaah...! Admire Groove~~~~~!!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...I don't need it.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: No need. It's grating on my ears...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: "...Don't come into my personal space."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I can win. —All on my own.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: I won't yield to anyone... ever again.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Nghh!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
(Alve-san... ngh, she's definitely even 
sharper than before...—)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: L o o k s S o G o o d !

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Not yet...! I can't... give up 
here...!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
This is SO good! Ahhh... I can't hold back 
anymore...!!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this is it... This is what I've been 
searching for... ♡

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, I must not, I cannot...! I made a 
promise with that person—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Yes. We did make a promise, didn't 
we?"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I'll win and offer it up to you. —By 
devouring everything!!
